text:
PagerBot: ALERT — spike in KMS decrypt errors for service=model-api in us-west-2. error rate ~420/min, started ~08:14 UTC. tagging @oncall. https://status.internal/redwood
Sam: I'm oncall, taking this. any deploys around 08:10?
Alex: I rolled a canary at 08:12 that switches REDWOOD_KMS_KEY to arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/key-2026 for the new key rotation test. seeing decrypt failures from canary hosts only.
Morgan: That was my canary. small percentage of traffic (5%) routed to canary. will pause rollouts if needed.
Alex: logs show repeated exception: 
```
ERROR ModelAPI KMSDecrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/model-api-sa is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/key-2026
at com.redwood.crypto.KMSClient.decrypt(KMSClient.java:142)
```
Leila: that looks like an IAM binding issue for the new key. can confirm these errors are KEYSPECIFIC, not a network or outage.
Sam: please try the kill-switch first (feature flag), then rollback if kill doesn't stop customer impact.
Alex: flipping feature flag `canary.use_new_kms` -> false now.
OpsBot: Feature flag `canary.use_new_kms` toggled OFF by Alex at 08:20 UTC.
Jen: Support: customer-visible errors are ~0.9% of requests globally, mostly 502 from model-api. I just ran a query for the last 10m. impacted customers: cust-9812, cust-7721, cust-4402 (top three). notifying CS to triage high-touch accounts.
Leila: After flag flip, canary hosts stop hitting KMS errors, error rate drops to baseline within 90s.
Morgan: Good. I'll start a rollback of the canary change to be safe — reverting env var to previous key pointer and re-deploying canary image without rotation.
OpsBot: Rollback initiated (deployment id deploy-4789). Rolling 4 canary instances back to stable config.
PagerBot: UPDATE — error rate returned to baseline at 08:23 UTC. Paging alert auto-resolved.
Sam: handing off to Tom for next shift at 09:00 UTC — leaving Slack for now. TL;DR: canary change hit missing kms:Decrypt permission on new key; feature flag kill + rollback mitigated.
Tom: Taking over. what's the plan for permanent fix?
Eva: Security: new key (key-2026) did not have a resource policy allowing the model-api role or the KMS grant/iam principal. I opened a ticket to request kms:Decrypt permission for role `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/model-api-role` and to add key policy entry.
Alex: quick repro steps: create key arn..., run canary with sa role -> AccessDenied. we should add a preflight step in deploy pipeline to run `aws kms simulate-principal-policy` or a dry-run decrypt with test ciphertext.
Morgan: Agreed. Action items: 1) Add preflight KMS permission check to rollout checklist (owner: Eng-Releases). 2) Update deploy playbook to include feature-flag kill instructions (owner: Eng-SRE). 3) Request keys team to update key policy and confirm. 4) Re-run a controlled canary only after policy change and audit (owner: Release).
Jen: Support note: incidents affecting <1% traffic, no SLA breach. CS informed top customers with short message and offer to share timeline.
Leila: marking incident resolved in tracker. I'll pair with Release to run the permission check in next canary.
PagerBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — root cause: new KMS key lacked Decrypt permission for service account leading to canary-only failures. mitigation: feature-flag kill-switch + rollback. postmortem required.
Morgan: I'll draft the postmortem and include a new preflight test. thanks everyone for quick responses. :thumbsup:
